verdict.rationale: Fly.io has no built-in natural-language interface. Its docs do list an experimental `flyctl mcp` server, which would let an external AI agent drive flyctl operations from natural-language prompts. The llms.txt file (HTTP 200) also makes the docs consumable by LLMs, but that supports the story only indirectly. Missing for 10: a native first-party natural-language command interface, a stable (non-experimental) MCP server, documentation of which operations work through natural language, and hands-on or independent confirmation that natural-language operation works.
